title: Continue saved mapping after resolving proven source references
changes: Resolve a code-unit reference to its exact owning Forms object only when the source proves the relationship.
Preserve the raw AI response and bind any resolved candidate separately to its original request and evidence.
Require independent review and downstream source-proof checks for the resolved candidate.
Offer explicit continuation of the same stopped run, reusing verified completed checkpoints without repeating their model calls.
Recheck current source, unchanged target, original code selection and three fresh consents before continuation.
Keep uncertain operations, missing proof and unsupported repairs blocked rather than automatically retrying.
limitations: Server-side preparation must be configured and tested by the operator; a source release does not enable it.
This hosted preparation route accepts one FMB per request; MMB, OLB and PLL require the separate supported preparation route.
The focused prototype profile, current authority endpoint and private browser worker require explicit operator configuration and live checks.
Real-file OPAF-to-APEX import, authenticated runtime and downloadable export acceptance remain pending.
A diagnostic source-reference correction is not independent review, completed conversion or proof of business behavior.
Continuation is limited to a proven source-reference error before the failed section's reviewer or any database stage. It is not general recovery of interrupted model calls or imports.
Technical identifiers are retained; redaction receipts are not complete PII certification or processing permission.
APEX generated, technical checks passed and business acceptance remain separate.
A prototype export does not prove clean-schema reimport, customer-target compatibility or business equivalence.
Release notes describe software changes, not proof of a successful conversion.
